title: Among players taller than 180 cm whose preferred foot is right, find those
question: Among players taller than 180 cm whose preferred foot is right, find those who played as away player 5 in any match of the 'Italy Serie A' during the 2015/2016 season, and return the top 5 by average heading accuracy.

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.XCL_122, AVG(pa.XCL_139) AS avg_heading_accuracy
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
JOIN Match m ON p.XCL_122 = m.XCL_068
JOIN League l ON m.XCL_008 = l.XCL_003
WHERE p.XCL_126 > 180
  AND pa.XCL_134 = 'right'
  AND l.XCL_005 = 'Italy Serie A'
  AND m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY p.XCL_122
ORDER BY avg_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 5
